scope: available bitmap to fake AndroidActionExecutor; no OS capture, gesture injection or game response
scriptDispatcher: Dispatchers.Default except script-farm-shared-thread* on single resource thread
limitations: Six paths rotate over six rounds, so each path starts once. Three warmups and twenty measured samples per path and round; 120 samples per path.
ScriptServiceDriver now selects its resource thread for the default interpreter; the benchmark also keeps Default as an explicit control.
Fixed available bitmap and fake gesture boundary; no MediaProjection, actual Android gestures, observation waiting or game response.
Diagnostic recording is measured, but no viewer is attached; UI rendering cost is not included.

CPU includes warmup, runtime validation/setup, legacy state initialization and instrumentation. Heap/PSS include fixtures, models, instrumentation and GC; these are not per-operation allocations or physical-device app measurements.
Recognition criteria and template pixels are checked for equivalence in every path; no thresholds or confirmations were relaxed.

Both shared-thread modes meet the previously fixed aggregate p50 <= 71 ms and p95 <= 77 ms limits for this confirmation stage. The legacy path also benefits from shared native detector optimizations and remains faster at p50.

JVM contract checks passed for blocking host calls, busy-code interruption, explicit cancellation and subsequent ownership reuse on a single dispatcher. Additional native checks remain pending at collection time.
Raw JSON is emitted after measurement as ordered benchmarkJsonPart keys, each at most 60000 characters, to avoid Binder size limits and test APK/cache removal.
